title: Whistler Eco Tours
specs: Paddle down the magical glacial River of Golden Dreams
Explore Whistler's expansive network of mountain-biking trails
blurb: Whistler Eco Tours offers guided canoeing, kayaking, hiking, and mountain biking tours. Guests explore Whistler's flora, fauna, history, and geology with interpretive guides. Tours include paddling on Alta Lake and the River of Golden Dreams, hiking, and mountain biking.
extraNote: Tours begin at Wayside Park on Alta Lake and the Whistler Village Office at the Delta Hotel.

quotes.text: My son and I had a great time biking and kayaking the River of Golden Dreams. Our guide Britney was super informative. She was also awesome with doing most of the harder stuff with getting her feet wet getting us over beaver dams and the bit of portaging we had to do. We also happened to see a young bear eating along the shore which was very cool.

Our day was perfect for a canoe ride, We went down the lake and paddled back up against the strong wind, making our return later than expected and the staff were nice and didn't charge us for the extra time taken coming back to drop off the canoe. Very good staff!
Thank you so much for producing such an amazing event. Your team did a great job facilitating a great experience for our school.
